dataset: Mumbai Administrative Boundary and Ward Geometries
source: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (MCGM / BMC) & OpenCity Data Portal
license: Open Government Data (OGD) License India / CC-BY 4.0
coverage: Greater Mumbai Municipal Corporation (437.71 sq km) + Island City, Western & Eastern Suburbs
file_size: Estimated ~35 KB across GeoJSON and configuration files
limitations: Ward boundaries represent official administrative delineation. Sub-ward electoral prabhag/constituency subdivisions (227 electoral wards) are aggregated into the 24 primary administrative wards.
processing: Digitized and harmonized from BMC ward boundaries and Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract into clean GeoJSON polygons in EPSG:4326 with standard attribute schemas.
notes: Includes full metadata for each ward: unique ward ID, official name, administrative zone, headquarters address, area in square kilometers, and population.
